what_works: Toulouse-pink brick tones layered with marble whites and ochre — the entire palette is regional architecture-derived rather than chosen for fashion. Editorial pacing with serif + sans pairing gives civic gravitas.
what_does_not_translate: Heritage-club institutional copy register won't carry for trades; the palette move (steal local material tones for the page) does.
type_observations: Classical serif display for authority, clean sans for body — pairing telegraphs 'institutional, not commercial.'
